title: OSINTTool
description: Schema for a single enriched OSINT tool record in OSINT Hub. Schema version 1.1.0.

id.description: Stable slug derived from tool name, e.g. 'spiderfoot'.

name.description: Display name of the tool as it appears in the source list.

url.description: Primary URL of the tool (homepage or GitHub repo).

raw_description.description: Original English description scraped from the Markdown source.

section.description: Source section heading the tool was extracted from, e.g. 'Basic OSINT'.

source_file.description: Relative path to the upstream Markdown file this record was parsed from.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the source Markdown was fetched.

is_dead_link.description: True if the source Markdown had the entry wrapped in ~~strikethrough~~.

description_zh_tw.description: Traditional Chinese description of the tool. LLM-enriched.

use_cases.description: Concrete, actionable use-case scenarios in Traditional Chinese. LLM-enriched.

tags.description: Taxonomy tags for structured navigation. LLM-enriched.

pricing.description: Pricing tier of the tool. LLM-enriched.

difficulty.description: Estimated skill level required to use the tool effectively. LLM-enriched.

target_types.description: What the tool targets or investigates. LLM-enriched. (renamed from target_type in schema 1.1.0)

platforms.description: Deployment/access platform(s) of the tool. (renamed from platform in schema 1.1.0)

ethical_flag.description: True if the LLM flagged this tool as ethically sensitive.

ethics_note.description: Neutral-tone explanation of ethical concerns in Traditional Chinese, if ethical_flag is true.

is_active.description: Whether the tool URL is currently reachable (set by link-check scripts).

enriched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when LLM enrichment was last run. Null if not yet enriched.

enrichment_model.description: LLM model identifier used for enrichment, e.g. 'gemini-2.0-flash'. Null if not yet enriched.

raw_tool_id.description: Provenance: id of the source RawTool record.

raw_content_hash.description: Provenance: SHA-256 of the raw tool content fingerprint (name|url|raw_description). Part of compound cache key.

prompt_hash.description: Provenance: SHA-256 of the enrichment prompt file content at time of enrichment. Part of compound cache key.

schema_version.description: Provenance: schema version string at time of enrichment. Part of compound cache key.

source_section.description: Provenance: section name within the upstream source (mirrors section field).

source_permalink.description: Provenance: section-level anchor permalink to the upstream README. Used until line-level permalink is available.

prompt_version.description: Provenance: human-readable version tag embedded in the prompt file header (e.g. '1.1.0').

review.description: Manual review metadata. Managed by editors, not by automated enrichment.

status.description: ai_candidate = produced by LLM, not yet reviewed. manually_reviewed = approved by a human. rejected = excluded from frontend.

reviewed_by.description: Display name or GitHub handle of the reviewer.

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when review was completed.
